_metadata.description: Validated component-to-design-style fit signals used by search, adoption workflows, and the console.

requirements.title: Design-style ids come from the canonical template registry
requirements.description: The component service loads design styles from `templates/design/*/metadata.json` and exposes them through `components styles` / `ComponentsService.ListDesignStyles`. Component manifests may only reference those style ids.

validation.notes: api/internal/components/styles_test.go verifies canonical style loading and unknown-id rejection.

requirements.title: Component manifests declare advisory design-style affinities
requirements.description: `component.json` supports `designStyles[]` entries with `styleId` and `affinity` (`native`, `compatible`, or `discouraged`). Indexing rejects unknown style ids, invalid affinities, and duplicate style ids.

validation.notes: api/internal/components/indexer_test.go verifies successful parsing and unknown-style rejection.

requirements.title: Affinities are indexed, searchable, and visible to operators
requirements.description: A fresh index populates `component_design_affinities`; component list/get responses include affinity rows; CLI and UI support style/affinity filtering and render discouraged-style badges.

validation.notes: api/internal/components/sqlite_test.go verifies persistence and style/affinity filtering; cli/domains/components and ComponentsCard tests verify operator surfaces.
Live dev DB re-index on 2026-07-08 indexed 10 components and populated 30 affinity rows.
